install: sed -i '/case \$- in/,/esac/d' "$HOME/.bashrc" 2>/dev/null || true; mkdir -p "$HOME/.npm-global"; export PATH="$HOME/.npm-global/bin:$PATH"; grep -qxF 'export PATH="$HOME/.npm-global/bin:$PATH"' "$HOME/.bashrc" || echo 'export PATH="$HOME/.npm-global/bin:$PATH"' >> "$HOME/.bashrc"; command -v serve >/dev/null 2>&1 || npm install -g --prefix "$HOME/.npm-global" serve --no-audit --no-fund
